# opwan_meta (Data Source)

The opwan server's version and terms of service. Needs no API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_meta" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) The API version.
- `terms_url` (String) Where the terms of service are published.
- `terms_version` (String) The terms of service version in effect.
- `version` (String) The server version.
